key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:28B8
name: update_buffers_with_scaled_deltas
description: Walks an index downward through several byte buffers, adding scaled signed deltas to each one. A lookup table indexed by bytes of a text buffer selects the scale factor, and the loop returns once the index passes zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:28D2
name: update_buffers_from_mid_entry
description: Enters the same downward delta-update loop as its neighbour at a point where the first delta is computed from a register value rather than a fixed constant. It then applies the table-driven scaling and returns when the index passes zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2906
name: walk_and_update_scaled_buffers
description: Repeats the scaled delta update over a downward index, choosing between two delta paths depending on a table-selected flag. Each pass adds a scaled value into the buffers and reloads the scale factor for the next step.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:295C
name: accumulate_scaled_bytes_by_flags
description: Walks an index downward and, for positions whose flag bits are set, adds a scaled byte delta into one buffer. A second scaled update is applied to the base buffer on each step.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:296A
name: scale_bytes_with_flag_tests
description: Walks an index downward, scaling one byte per step by a fixed factor and subtracting it from a second buffer. Flag tests decide whether a derived delta is also added, and the loop ends when the index passes zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2970
name: update_buffers_with_fixed_scale
description: Applies a scaled delta to the buffers at each index step using a fixed initial scale factor. Flag bytes decide whether the scale is reloaded from a table, and the routine returns when the index reaches minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:298E
name: update_attribute_buffers_downward
description: Walks an index downward, reading a byte from one buffer and using it to scale a signed delta. The delta is added into several buffers, with a table lookup on the text buffer selecting the factor for each step.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29A2
name: copy_bytes_with_feedback_update
description: Copies one byte forward in a buffer per step and multiplies a running feedback value by a table entry, shifting the result. It subtracts the feedback from the copied byte, writes the result plus five to a second buffer, and runs for a count held in a register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29A4
name: copy_adjusted_bytes_with_feedback
description: Repeats the same copy-and-feedback step as its neighbour, but runs as a do-while loop over a count. Each copied byte is adjusted by the feedback value and written to a second output buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29D4
name: invoke_step_routine_twelve_times
description: Calls the same unnamed step routine twelve times in a row, then calls it once more only if a flag byte in the structure pointed to by the base register is non-zero. It returns no value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A4A
name: invoke_step_routine_three_times
description: Calls the same unnamed step routine three times in succession and then returns. It has no other logic of its own.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A6A
name: interpolate_and_store_bytes
description: Linearly interpolates between the first byte of a buffer and a second byte, using a division by a count derived from the index. It stores the running result into every eighth byte of the buffer and skips the bytes in between.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A92
name: walk_records_until_terminator
description: Scans a table of eight-byte records and ends at a terminator byte of minus one. A run of markers equal to minus two is skipped, and the step routine is called for entries that break the run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AA4
name: walk_marker_table_calling_step
description: Walks a byte table of eight-byte records and calls the step routine when an entry's marker differs from the expected value. It stops at a terminator byte of minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AB6
name: scan_record_table_after_step
description: Calls the step routine once and then scans forward through a record table, advancing one eight-byte record at a time. It returns when it finds a terminator byte of minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2ABA
name: process_nonzero_records_until_end
description: Scans a table of eight-byte records, skipping zero bytes, and stops at a terminator byte of minus one. A record whose marker is not in the first slot triggers the step routine; otherwise the scan moves to the next record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AD0
name: advance_records_until_terminator
description: Advances through a table of eight-byte records, calling the step routine when the scan position is not in the first slot. It skips runs of zero bytes until it reaches a terminator byte of minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2ADC
name: call_step_then_skip_zero_runs
description: Calls the step routine, then skips runs of zero bytes across eight-byte records. It returns when it reaches a terminator byte of minus one and otherwise continues with the next record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AE0
name: expand_coded_entries_into_buffer
description: Expands a sequence of code bytes, terminated by minus one, into an output buffer, using a parallel array of counts. Plain codes advance the output pointer in eight-byte steps, while codes with the table flag set copy five values from a table into each group.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B10
name: expand_coded_entries_with_stride
description: Performs the same coded-entry expansion as its neighbour, but takes the table stride from a register, so the pattern copies use a variable step. It stops when the terminator value of minus one is read from the code stream.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B6A
name: expand_coded_rows_with_stride
description: Repeats the coded-entry expansion in an outer loop, advancing the output by a register-held stride after each pass. Flagged codes copy a five-value table pattern per count, and the other codes skip ahead in eight-byte steps or apply a small additive change to a group of bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B70
name: expand_codes_with_inner_pattern
description: Writes a five-value table pattern for each count in the code stream and handles the remaining codes by skipping eight-byte steps or applying small additive changes. The loop ends when the code stream reaches minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B82
name: expand_pattern_codes_subset
description: Expands a subset of pattern codes into five-value groups from a table, with the code byte selecting the table offset. Other codes use the same skip and additive-update logic as the neighbouring expansion routines.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B92
name: expand_pattern_codes_comma_only
description: Expands pattern codes into five-value table groups for a code byte that selects one of two offsets. Remaining codes are handled with the skip and additive-update logic shared with the neighbouring routines.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BA2
name: expand_pattern_codes_default_offset
description: Runs the coded-entry expansion with a default table offset and switches to alternate offsets for three special code bytes. Other codes are handled by skip or additive-update logic, and a register is cleared whenever a special code is taken.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BC6
name: update_row_pairs_from_codes
description: Walks a code stream and an output buffer together. Codes one and two copy two bytes from the previous eight-byte row, and flagged codes rewrite the high nibble of paired rows; each code advances the output by its count in eight-byte steps.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BF2
name: copy_rows_and_merge_nibbles
description: Processes a code stream against a parallel mask stream, copying three bytes from the previous row for codes one and two. For other flagged codes it merges split nibble values into paired rows, and the loop ends when the stop value held in a register is read.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2C02
name: merge_nibbles_by_code_mask
description: Walks a code stream with a parallel mask stream and applies the same row copy and nibble merge as its neighbour, using masks held in registers. It ends after the code matching the stop value has been processed.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2C32
name: merge_nibbles_with_row_copy
description: Walks two streams to copy previous-row bytes for codes one and two and to merge split nibble values into the output rows for other flagged codes. It loops until the stop value is read.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2CEC
name: merge_row_nibbles_until_stop
description: Walks a code stream and a mask stream, merging split nibble values into paired output rows for flagged codes and copying previous-row bytes for codes one and two. It returns when an unflagged code ends the loop.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D1C
name: remap_row_bytes_through_table
description: Walks a buffer of eight-byte rows from a starting offset and replaces the first three bytes of each row with values looked up in a global table. A row whose first byte is minus two is skipped, and the loop ends at minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D3E
name: gather_bytes_through_index_table
description: Copies bytes from a source table, selected by a running index, into eight-byte output rows, and takes the next index from each row's byte. It repeats until the scanned byte no longer matches a stop value held in a register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D52
name: stub_return_immediately
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D54
name: sum_column_bytes_per_entry
description: For each entry in a table, sums seven bytes at a fixed stride starting from that entry, then stores the total, shifted right by three, at a fixed offset within the entry. It advances entry by entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D70
name: accumulate_running_sums_per_row
description: Walks a byte table in eight-byte steps, keeping a running total of the bytes it reads. It writes the total, shifted right by three, into a fixed offset of each row, and ends when a byte equal to a stop value held in a register is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D86
name: weighted_row_sums_into_entry
description: Repeats a weighted-sum update over successive eight-byte rows. Each row's stored value is recomputed from a sum of seven bytes at a fixed stride, the row's leading byte and the previous stored value scaled by four, shifted right by four.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DA4
name: accumulate_weighted_sums_until_stop
description: Walks a byte table in eight-byte steps, accumulating doubled byte values into a running total. It writes a shifted combination of that total and nearby bytes into each row, and the loop ends at a stop value held in a register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DCA
name: apply_code_offsets_to_row_field
description: Processes a code stream paired with a count stream and adds a per-code offset to a field of each eight-byte row. Some codes write a fixed offset across their count, while others add a value derived from the row bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DEC
name: apply_code_offsets_to_rows
description: Processes a stream of codes with paired counts, applying a fixed or derived offset to a field of each eight-byte row for each code. Codes matching the flag tests use the combined form, and the loop repeats until the code stream ends at minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E38
name: apply_ten_offset_to_field_rows
description: Enters the shared code-driven row update with a starting offset of ten added to each row field. Later codes may switch to other constants or to a derived value, and the loop stops at minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E48
name: apply_minus_six_offset_rows
description: Enters the shared code-driven row update with a starting offset of minus six added to each row field. Codes branch to a ten offset or a derived value, and the loop stops at minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E4C
name: apply_minus_six_then_derived_offsets
description: Adds a starting offset of minus six to each row field and then applies derived offsets for codes with the matching flag bits. It shares its loop with the neighbouring entry points and stops at minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E50
name: apply_minus_six_with_stop_check
description: Applies a starting offset of minus six to each row field and returns when the flag bits of the current code end the update. It shares its loop with the neighbouring routines.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E54
name: apply_minus_twenty_six_offsets
description: Adds a constant of minus twenty-six to a field of each row for the count given by the current code. Later codes may add ten, minus six or a derived value, depending on their flag bits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E68
name: apply_derived_offset_row_update
description: Enters the shared code-driven row update with a starting offset derived from the row's first byte, then continues processing codes with the same branch logic as its neighbours. It stops when the code stream reaches minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E80
name: write_nibble_checksums_per_group
description: Processes groups of bytes in two passes. The first pass sums the low nibbles of each group and writes a shifted result into the low nibble of a fixed byte in the group, and the second pass sums the high nibbles into the high nibble of the same byte. The group count comes from a structure field.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5230
name: request_signal_mask_and_loop
description: Requests a signal bit from the operating system through library calls, stores it in a structure, and combines it with a second bit into a mask stored in another field. It then loops, calling a helper and waiting on the signal.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:526E
name: service_flagged_library_request_loop
description: Loops over a status flag byte in a structure, setting its low bit and leaving the loop if it was already set. Each pass makes a library call, stores the returned pointer unless a type field equals two, sets a status bit and calls a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:52A4
name: clear_low_status_flag_bits
description: Clears the two lowest status bits in a flag byte of a structure and returns. It has no other logic.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:52B4
name: prepare_speech_request_and_send
description: Fills in the speech I/O request block with pointers to tables, sample length and channel fields, and a rate computed by dividing a constant by a stored value. It then runs a loop that expands nibble-coded samples through lookup tables into one of two buffers, switching buffers each time one fills, and sends the request with an I/O call. Audio DMA control writes bracket the loop.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5370
name: prepare_speech_block_and_expand
description: Copies a block of input bytes into a work buffer, fills in the speech request block with table pointers and a rate computed by division, and then expands table-coded samples into one of two buffers. Audio DMA control writes surround the loop, and the buffer switch toggles each time a block fills.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:548A
name: expand_table_coded_samples_loop
description: Expands table-coded samples into the current output buffer by summing three lookup-table values per sample, with counters held in a structure. When a block fills it switches to the other buffer, and a separate branch handles a second coded source when a flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5514
name: synthesize_speech_frames_loop
description: Continues the speech sample synthesis loop: reads a control byte for each frame, selects a per-frame table pointer from its control bits, and mixes three table lookups per sample into the active output buffer. Buffers are toggled at block boundaries, and the loop re-enters at its update step.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:558C
name: synthesize_speech_frames_indexed
description: Walks a frame table with per-frame control bytes and synthesizes samples with the same three-lookup mixing and buffer toggling as its neighbour. The table pointer comes from the frame control value, and the routine ends when the frame counter passes zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5610
name: finish_speech_frame_synthesis
description: Completes a speech synthesis pass by mixing the remaining samples of the current frame, then reads frame control bytes until a negative byte ends the stream. It finishes by writing the audio DMA control register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56AE
name: step_speech_sample_phase
description: Advances a phase counter that bounces between the ends of a range, then synthesizes speech samples into the output buffer with the same frame-driven mixing. It repeats for each frame until a negative control byte is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56DC
name: resume_speech_frame_stream
description: Resumes frame-driven synthesis after a phase update by decrementing the sample counter and, when it passes zero, reading the next frame control bytes and mixing that frame's samples. It loops until a negative control byte ends the stream.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56EA
name: wait_io_per_channel_then_dma
description: Calls the operating system's wait-for-I/O routine once for each entry in a channel list, after writing the audio DMA control register with the enable bit set when a status flag is found. The same flag check is repeated after the waits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:573E
name: enable_audio_dma_if_flagged
description: Writes the audio DMA control register with the enable bit set when a status flag in the structure is set, and returns. It has no other logic.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5758
name: update_channel_and_requeue_node
description: Disables interrupts while it updates a per-channel byte and, when that byte changes and a matching list node is present, moves the node and queues it with a library call. It decrements a counter in the structure and re-enables interrupts when the counter was at most one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57CA
name: decrement_counter_enable_interrupts_if_idle
description: Decrements a counter byte in the structure and, when the counter was not positive before the decrement, writes the interrupt value that sets the enable bit. It has no other logic.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57DA
name: flush_channel_entries_and_dma
description: Marks each entry in a channel block with a status bit and calls a library routine on it, then clears the block's active bit. When that bit was clear it writes the audio DMA control register and repeats the library call per entry; otherwise it sets a field to seven and makes one library call.

name: set_channel_status_bit

name: call_unnamed_intro_routine
description: Program entry that makes one call to an unnamed routine and references the text IMP!. The decompiler gave no pseudo-code, so the body is known only from that call and the text reference.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:001A
name: touch_background_color_then_call
description: Touches the background color register and calls a jump-table entry and an unnamed routine. The decompiler timed out, so the body is known only from these calls and the register it uses.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:0048
name: decode_backward_copy_stream
description: Decodes a compressed bit stream by repeatedly copying runs of bytes backwards from earlier output, with run lengths and distances read through lookup tables. It stops when the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:009A
name: decode_backward_copy_variant
description: Runs the same bit-serial backward-copy decoding as its neighbour, but with its own length and distance tables and a different offset term. It writes into the buffer in reverse order until the stream ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:00D2
name: continue_backward_copy_decoding
description: Continues the bit-serial backward-copy decoder: it reads a length and a distance from the stream through lookup tables, copies that run backwards in the output, and stops when the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:00F6
name: decode_backward_copy_five_run
description: Enters the same backward-copy decoder with a starting run length of five and a distance table lookup. It copies runs backwards into the output until the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:00FC
name: decode_backward_copy_four_run
description: Enters the backward-copy decoder with a starting run length of four and a distance table lookup. It copies runs backwards into the output until the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:0102
name: decode_backward_copy_three_run
description: Enters the backward-copy decoder with a starting run length of three. It copies runs backwards into the output until the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:0108
name: decode_backward_copy_two_run
description: Enters the backward-copy decoder with a starting run length of two and an initial distance index of zero. It copies runs backwards into the output until the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:012C
name: decode_backward_copy_fresh_start
description: Starts the backward-copy decoder with a distance base of two and reads run and distance codes from the bit stream before copying backwards. The loop matches the other decoder entries in this segment and stops when the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:0168
name: decode_backward_copy_table_entry
description: Enters the backward-copy decoder with a run length taken from a table at an index held in a register. It then reads the distance bits and copies backwards into the output until the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

name: increment_count_clear_flag_bit

name: decrement_count_and_call_when_flagged
description: Decrements a 16-bit count in a library structure and, when the count reaches zero and a flag bit is set, calls a helper and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0070
name: unlink_node_or_flag_pending
description: When a count field in a library structure is zero, removes a node from a doubly linked list and calls a library routine with a stored value. Otherwise it sets a pending flag bit and returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:008A
name: unlink_node_and_call_library
description: Removes a node from a doubly linked list by relinking its neighbours, then calls a library routine with a value stored in the node. It returns no value of its own.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0134
name: scan_text_buffer_with_markers
description: Fills a work area with space characters, then scans an input string, checking for a hash marker and for spaces before calling helpers on each segment. It returns the value from the final helper call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:01A4
name: return_low_word_value
description: Returns the low word of a data register as an integer and does nothing else.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:01A8
name: call_helper_clear_byte_return
description: Calls a helper, clears one byte at a pointer held in a register, and returns the low word of a second register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:01CA
name: scan_until_marker_or_space
description: Loops over an input string calling helpers, and stops when the byte before the cursor is a hash marker or a space character. It returns the value of the last helper call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:01E6
name: scan_segments_return_last_result
description: Scans an input string for hash markers and spaces, calling helpers for each segment. It returns the value from the last helper call when the segment count runs out.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0202
name: scan_to_backslash_or_backtick
description: Reads bytes from a buffer until a backslash or grave-accent character is found, calling helpers at each boundary. The loop repeats while the zero flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0226
name: scan_delimited_bytes_with_helper
description: Reads bytes from a buffer and calls a helper whenever a backslash or grave-accent delimiter is found. The loop continues until the caller stops it.

name: skip_to_bracket_and_match

description: Decrements a byte once per count step, replacing a result of zero with a space character, until the count passes minus one. It makes no memory accesses or calls.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains invalid instruction bytes rather than executable code, so the decompiler truncated it. It has no behaviour of its own.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:0000
name: initialise_program_state_block
description: Program entry that calls a helper, clears twenty-three longwords relative to a base register, and stores the initial register value and a global. It then calls one of two routines depending on whether a returned pointer is zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:0004
name: open_system_libraries_and_init
description: Opens the operating system libraries through library calls, raising an alert when a required open fails. It then walks a table of structures and calls a routine for each entry, with the library names for dos, graphics and intuition referenced in the code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:0180
name: stub_return_empty_init
description: Empty routine that returns immediately with no work.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:0188
name: allocate_and_open_dos_file
description: Allocates a block of memory through a library call, initialises its fields and stores a tag value. It then either opens a file through the dos wrapper routines or calls a library routine with the stored block.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:02C0
name: allocate_and_copy_named_string
description: Computes a buffer length from a stored string, requests memory through a library call, and copies a string into the new buffer up to its terminator. The decompiler output for this routine is incomplete, so only the start of the copy is shown.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:0486
name: append_string_with_fixed_cap
description: Finds the end of a destination string and appends a source string to it, copying at most a fixed number of bytes and writing a terminator if the copy is cut short.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:048E
name: append_string_with_count_limit
description: Finds the end of a destination string and copies a source string onto it, stopping at a terminator or when a count held in a third argument expires. If the count expires first, it writes a terminator at the next destination byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:04B2
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source string up to a count or a null terminator, then fills the rest of the count with zero bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:04D4
name: open_icon_library_window_entry
description: Opens a library by name and, on success, looks up a window-related entry and stores two values in the calling structure. It closes the library handle afterwards and clears the stored pointer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:0586
name: run_optional_callback_then_release
description: Calls a stored callback when one is set, then makes one more unnamed call and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:0588
name: run_optional_callback_then_finish
description: Calls a stored callback when one is set, then makes one more unnamed call and returns. It is the same sequence as its neighbour, reached from a second caller.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:05A6
name: release_program_resource_tables
description: Releases resources held in the global structure: when a table is set it calls a helper for each entry and then frees the table. It also calls helpers for other stored handles and clears the stored values.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:06C2
name: close_indexed_table_entry
description: Checks an index against the table size and, when the entry is valid, calls a helper to close it unless a flag bit is set. It clears the entry and returns zero on success, or minus one with an error code when the index or entry is invalid.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:073C
name: call_output_vector_from_struct
description: Calls a library routine at a fixed negative offset from a base pointer stored in a structure. The facts list this as the dos Output call, and the routine returns no value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:076C
name: call_library_vector_from_struct
description: Calls a library function through a base pointer held in a structure, at a fixed negative offset, and returns no value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:07BA
name: call_library_vector_through_pointer
description: Calls a library routine through a base pointer loaded from a global, at a fixed negative offset, and returns no value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:add21k:0:081E
name: call_library_routine_by_pointer
description: Calls a library routine through a pointer in a structure at a fixed negative offset, then returns. The facts list a library call at a fixed offset as its only callee.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 2 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 2 of 3).adf:paradox:0:0000
name: run_entry_with_conditional_library_call
description: Program entry routine that calls a helper, then, when the zero flag test is false, calls a second helper and a library function pointer loaded from a global table. It finishes with a third helper call; its listed callees are the output and close-library wrappers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 2 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 2 of 3).adf:paradox:0:0034
name: open_dos_library
description: Opens the dos library through the exec library's old-open call and stores the returned handle in a global variable. It returns after that single call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 2 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 2 of 3).adf:paradox:0:004E
name: close_exec_library_handle
description: Calls the exec library's CloseLibrary routine through the global library base and returns its result.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 3 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 3 of 3).adf:paradox:0:0000
name: run_entry_with_conditional_library_call
description: Program entry routine that calls a helper, then, when the zero flag test is false, calls a second helper and a library function pointer loaded from a global table. It finishes with a third helper call; its listed callees are the output and close-library wrappers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 3 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 3 of 3).adf:paradox:0:0034
name: open_dos_library
description: Opens the dos library through the exec library's old-open call and stores the returned handle in a global variable. It returns after that single call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 3 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 3 of 3).adf:paradox:0:004E
name: close_exec_library_handle
description: Calls the exec library's CloseLibrary routine through the global library base and returns its result.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 2 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 2 of 3).adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: boot_check_dos_library_open
description: Boot block entry that calls a library function and returns zero when the call gives a non-zero result, and minus one when it gives zero. The text reference is to dos.library.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 3 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 3 of 3).adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: boot_check_dos_library_open
description: Boot block entry that calls a library function and returns zero when the call gives a non-zero result, and minus one when it gives zero. The text reference is to dos.library.

key: runtime segment $0800B0-$0800F0:0:0008
name: stub_empty_runtime_entry
description: Empty routine at a runtime address that does nothing when executed.

key: runtime segment $C1A0C0-$C1A580:0:0008
name: stub_return_runtime_ciaa_entry
description: Runtime entry whose displayed body only returns. The facts show it touches the CIAA port register that carries fire button and disk status, but no read or write appears in the decompiled output.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:0000
name: start_process_with_message_port
description: Program entry that allocates memory, opens the dos library by name and duplicates the current directory lock. It then sets up a message port and waits on it with signal calls, branching on fields of the process structure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:020C
name: release_process_resources_reply
description: Releases process resources by unlocking a directory lock, closing a library, freeing allocated memory and replying to a message, with task switching forbidden during the message step. Two routines call it, and it calls one helper.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:02A8
name: call_stored_vector_with_global
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer stored in a global, passing the address of a global variable, and then returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:02AE
name: call_stored_vector_no_return
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer stored in a global, passing the address of a global variable. It has no return value of its own.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:02B4
name: tokenize_command_line_arguments
description: Walks a command-line string, skipping spaces, tabs and newlines, and splits it into tokens. Double-quoted text is kept together, an asterisk acts as an escape, and a stored count is reset at the start.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:02BC
name: check_stream_and_set_flag
description: Calls a helper on a fixed buffer, then a second helper on its result. When that reports failure it sets a status byte; otherwise it calls two more helpers. It returns whether the second call succeeded.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:02FA
name: set_status_byte_to_one
description: Sets a status byte in a structure to one and returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:0818
name: advance_counter_on_matched_read
description: Checks a status byte and reads a chunk through a helper. When the read returns the requested length, it adds that length to a running counter; it returns zero on success and two on a short read.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:0836
name: add_length_on_full_read
description: Calls a helper to read data and compares its result with the requested length. A full read adds that length to a running counter and returns zero; a short read returns two.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:084E
name: add_length_to_running_counter
description: Adds a length value to a running counter in a structure, with no return value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:142E
name: free_linked_node_list
description: Walks a singly linked list, releasing each node through a helper call with a fixed size, then clears the list head and tail pointers.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:144C
name: clear_list_head_and_tail
description: Sets the head and tail pointers of a list in a structure to zero and returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:162C
name: pack_six_flags_into_byte
description: Packs six flag bytes in a structure into one value by OR-ing in the bit values four, eight, sixteen, thirty-two, sixty-four and one hundred and twenty-eight for each nonzero flag.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:51C8
name: parse_command_options
description: Parses command-line options by scanning argument tokens for option letters and dispatching on each letter in a switch. It sets flags in the structure and reports an error for unknown letters, after first clearing two option fields.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5B7C
name: scan_next_option_token
description: Advances through an argument list, skipping entries that begin with a dash, and copies the first one or two characters of the next argument into an output byte. It returns a pointer to a result string or a null pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5B82
name: scan_option_argument_entries
description: Advances through an argument list in the same way as its neighbour but handles more cases. It returns a pointer to a result string or a null pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5C24
name: next_nonoption_argument
description: Walks an argument list, skipping dash-prefixed options and noting a double-dash terminator. It returns the next non-option argument, or a null pointer when the list ends.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5C8E
name: parse_slash_separated_range_fields
description: Parses a slash-separated text field whose first number must fall in a fixed range, storing it as a character offset from the letter N. Further numeric fields are checked against bounds, and the routine returns one on a bad field and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5CBA
name: parse_slash_field_with_bounds
description: Continues parsing slash-separated fields, storing a numeric field after the first and checking it against a bound. It returns one for a missing or out-of-range field.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5CD2
name: parse_slash_field_remainder
description: Skips a leading slash, then parses a numeric field and checks it against a bound. It returns one for an empty or out-of-range field.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5CE4
name: parse_bounded_numeric_fields
description: Parses a numeric field stored at a fixed offset and checks it against an upper bound of twelve, then parses a following slash-separated field checked against thirty-one. It returns one on any failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5D00
name: parse_field_bounded_thirty_one
description: Skips to the next slash-separated field and parses a numeric value that must not exceed thirty-one. It stores the value and returns one for an empty or out-of-range field.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5D0E
name: check_field_bounded_thirty_one
description: Skips a leading slash, then parses a numeric value that must not exceed thirty-one. It stores the value and returns one on an empty or out-of-range field.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5D20
name: store_bounded_field_thirty_one
description: Parses a numeric value and stores it, returning one when the value is zero or above thirty-one and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5D3C
name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine with no body, called by five unnamed routines.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5D44
name: initialise_playback_state_fields
description: Sets a block of state flags and parameter fields in a structure to fixed starting values, including several counters and constants. It makes no calls and returns after the assignments.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5E10
name: pause_task_until_key_press
description: Looks up the current task and changes its priority through library calls when a pause flag is set. The routine references the paused prompt text, and it returns a character after the priority update.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5E8C
name: skip_characters_in_class
description: Scans a string through a character-class table, advancing past characters whose class bit is set, then calls one helper. It returns zero when given a null pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5E92
name: run_callback_list_then_helper
description: Walks a linked list of callback nodes, calling the routine stored in each node, then makes one helper call with its parameter and returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5E98
name: configure_handler_and_dispatch
description: Calls three helpers in sequence, makes two more calls when a mode byte is below two, installs a handler pointer in the structure, and then calls a helper with a stored configuration byte.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5FEC
name: open_arp_library_and_set_mode
description: Looks up the current task and, depending on a stored size field, either sets a flag and opens a library by name or sets a bit in a related structure. It reads input-state bits to choose a mode byte, and the library name referenced is arp.library.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:607A
name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Calls one unnamed helper routine and returns. It acts as a thin forwarding entry reached through a handler pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:6080
name: save_and_clear_structure_slot
description: Saves a 32-bit field from a structure into a global slot, overwrites that field with minus one, and sets a flag byte. It returns without other work.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:70A8
name: call_temp_file_name_helper
description: Calls a helper with an address computed from a per-entry structure, passing the file-name template referenced in the text for a temporary LZX compression file. It returns no value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7B74
name: clear_block_match_name
description: Clears a block of 144 bytes, then compares the given name with a stored string and sets a result code when they match. The routine continues with a second comparison when they do not.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7BAC
name: compare_name_against_constants
description: Compares a name with a stored string and, on a match, sets a result code. Otherwise it compares against a second stored string and sets the code the same way.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7BC6
name: match_name_then_set_result
description: Compares a name with a stored string and sets a result code on a match. Otherwise it compares the name against a second stored string and sets the code for that match.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7BE0
name: match_name_or_open_file
description: Compares a name with a stored string and, when it does not match, passes the name and a fixed length to a helper. When no flag is set and the result code matches, it calls a library routine to open the file and returns a status value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7BFA
name: open_file_by_mode_or_report
description: Passes a name and a fixed length to a helper, then, when a flag is clear and the result code matches, tries to lock the file through library calls. On failure it releases the handle; on success it stores the handle in the caller's slot. It also references an error message for an unknown open mode.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C34
name: store_handle_or_close_on_failure
description: Calls a library function to obtain a handle. On success it stores the handle, otherwise it calls a second library function to release the failed attempt. It returns true when no handle was obtained.
